title: Pintu Pigeon, CEO. Ep 1: The Drone
logline: A proud delivery pigeon loses every customer to a 10-minute delivery drone, until one lunch box needs to go where no drone can fly.

series.title: Pintu Pigeon, CEO
series.season_arc: Pintu defends Pigeon Express against bigger and stranger delivery machines while building a crew of rooftop misfits.
series.cliffhanger: A hundred drones rise over the skyline behind Pintu.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest stands on a water tank holding a small brown parcel in his beak. Drona, a sleek glossy white delivery drone with four black rotors, one glowing red camera eye and a small blue cargo box underneath zooms past and snatches the parcel away, leaving him spinning. Fast whip-pan following the drone.
shots.on_screen_text: A drone just stole his job.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest stamps tiny parcels at a desk made from a matchbox on top of a blue water tank, under a hand-painted wooden sign with a pigeon logo. Slow push-in, morning sun.
shots.voiceover: Narrator: For nineteen years, Pintu ran the fastest delivery service in Mumbai.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. shots.dialogue: Pintu: Pigeon Express. No app, no battery, no problem.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. shots.voiceover: Narrator: Then Drona arrived. Ten-minute delivery.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Two-shot on a water tank. Drona, a sleek glossy white delivery drone with four black rotors, one glowing red camera eye and a small blue cargo box underneath hovers face to face with Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest, its red eye scanning him up and down. The drone says in a flat robotic voice: "You are obsolete, bird. Estimated retirement: now." The pigeon's feathers ruffle in the rotor wind.
shots.dialogue: Drona: You are obsolete, bird. Estimated retirement: now.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Sunset. Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest sits alone beside an empty chalkboard on a water tank, a single feather drifting down past him. shots.voiceover: Narrator: By evening, Pintu had zero orders.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. shots.dialogue: Ammaji: My grandson forgot his lunch! Fourth floor, the window with the grille!

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Drona, a sleek glossy white delivery drone with four black rotors, one glowing red camera eye and a small blue cargo box underneath carrying a small steel lunch box flies straight into a clothesline of colourful sarees and kite strings stretched between two buildings, gets wrapped up and spins helplessly, dropping the lunch box. Side view, comic slow motion.
shots.voiceover: Narrator: Drona calculated the fastest route. Drona did not calculate laundry.

shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, bright colourful 3D animated cartoon, soft cinematic lighting, a sunny Mumbai rooftop neighbourhood with blue water tanks, clotheslines and satellite dishes. Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest dives off a water tank, catches a falling small steel lunch box by its handle in mid-air, and swoops gracefully under rows of clotheslines between buildings. On a balcony, Ammaji, a 70-year-old Indian grandmother with silver hair in a bun, round gold spectacles, wearing a purple cotton saree and a white cardigan gently pats the head of Pintu, a plump grey city pigeon with a shiny green-and-purple neck, big expressive brown eyes, wearing a tiny red waistcoat with gold buttons and a miniature black leather satchel across his chest, who salutes with one wing. She says warmly: "From tomorrow, only Pintu." Neighbours clap on balconies in the background.
